module AcyclicLayering
  def self.neighbors(count, edges)
    upper, lower = Array.new(count) { [] }, Array.new(count) { [] }
    edges.each { |a, b| lower[a] << b; upper[b] << a }
    [upper, lower]
  end

  def self.acyclic_order(count, edges)
    upper, lower = neighbors(count, edges)
    remaining = (0...count).to_a
    head, tail = [], []
    until remaining.empty?
      indegree = remaining.to_h { |v| [v, upper[v].count { |u| remaining.include?(u) }] }
      outdegree = remaining.to_h { |v| [v, lower[v].count { |u| remaining.include?(u) }] }
      sink = remaining.find { |v| outdegree[v].zero? }
      source = remaining.find { |v| indegree[v].zero? }
      if sink
        chosen = sink
        tail.unshift(chosen)
      else
        chosen = source || remaining.min_by { |v| [indegree[v] - outdegree[v], v] }
        head << chosen
      end
      remaining.delete(chosen)
    end
    head + tail
  end

  def self.heights(count, edges, settings)
    upper, lower = neighbors(count, edges)
    height = Array.new(count)
    labels = nil
    if settings['layering'] == 'coffman'
      labels = Array.new(count)
      (1..count).each do |label|
        candidates = (0...count).select { |v| labels[v].nil? && upper[v].all? { |u| labels[u] } }
        chosen = candidates.min_by { |v| [upper[v].map { |u| labels[u] }.sort.reverse, v] }
        labels[chosen] = label
      end
      current = occupied = 0
      count.times do
        chosen = (0...count).select { |v| height[v].nil? && lower[v].all? { |w| height[w] } }.max_by { |v| labels[v] }
        if occupied == settings['width'] || lower[chosen].any? { |w| height[w] == current }
          current += 1
          occupied = 0
        end
        height[chosen] = current
        occupied += 1
      end
    else
      count.times do
        v = (0...count).find { |u| height[u].nil? && lower[u].all? { |w| height[w] } }
        height[v] = lower[v].map { |w| height[w] + 1 }.max || 0
      end
    end
    before = edges.sum { |a, b| height[a] - height[b] - 1 }
    rounds = 0
    record = []
    promote = lambda do |v|
      diff = 0
      upper[v].each { |u| diff += promote.call(u) if height[u] == height[v] + 1 }
      height[v] += 1
      diff + lower[v].size - upper[v].size
    end
    if settings['promotion'] == 'on'
      loop do
        rounds += 1
        accepted = 0
        count.times do |v|
          next if upper[v].empty?
          saved = height.dup
          diff = promote.call(v)
          if diff.negative?
            record << [rounds, v, diff]
            accepted += 1
          else
            height.replace(saved)
          end
        end
        break if accepted.zero?
      end
    end
    [height, labels, before, rounds, record]
  end
end

require 'set'
require_relative 'crossing'

module Coordinates
  VARIANTS = %w[ul ur dl dr].freeze
  Result = Struct.new(:x, :left, :right, :aligned, :blocks, :widths, :smallest, :conflicts)

  def self.assign(orders, upper, lower, widths, nodes, settings)
    count = widths.size
    vertical = %w[TB BT].include?(settings['direction'])
    left = widths.map { |w| vertical ? (w - 1) / 2 : 0 }
    right = widths.each_with_index.map { |w, v| vertical ? w - 1 - left[v] : 0 }
    pos = Crossing.positions(orders)
    marked = Set.new
    orders.each_cons(2) do |above, below|
      k0 = start = 0
      below.each_with_index do |v, last|
        inner = v >= nodes && upper[v][0] >= nodes
        next unless inner || last == below.size - 1
        k1 = inner ? pos[upper[v][0]] : above.size - 1
        below[start..last].each do |w|
          upper[w].each { |u| marked << [u, w] if pos[u] < k0 || pos[u] > k1 }
        end
        start, k0 = last + 1, k1
      end
    end
    layouts, blocks, bounds, spans = {}, {}, {}, {}
    VARIANTS.each do |variant|
      leftward = variant[1] == 'l'
      upward = variant[0] == 'u'
      scan = orders.map { |layer| leftward ? layer.dup : layer.reverse }
      rank = Crossing.positions(scan)
      root = (0...count).to_a
      align = root.dup
      layers = (0...orders.size).to_a
      layers.reverse! unless upward
      reference = upward ? upper : lower
      layers.drop(1).each do |i|
        rho = -1
        scan[i].each do |v|
          neighbors = reference[v].sort_by { |u| rank[u] }
          next if neighbors.empty?
          [(neighbors.size - 1) / 2, neighbors.size / 2].each do |m|
            u = neighbors[m]
            segment = upward ? [u, v] : [v, u]
            next unless align[v] == v && !marked.include?(segment) && rho < rank[u]
            align[u] = v
            root[v] = root[u]
            align[v] = root[v]
            rho = rank[u]
          end
        end
      end
      representatives = root.uniq.sort
      incoming = representatives.to_h { |v| [v, {}] }
      outgoing = representatives.to_h { |v| [v, {}] }
      scan.each do |layer|
        layer.each_cons(2) do |first, second|
          a, b = leftward ? [first, second] : [second, first]
          gap = settings[a < nodes && b < nodes ? 'node_sep' : 'dummy_sep']
          distance = right[a] + left[b] + 1 + gap
          origin, target = root[first], root[second]
          distance = [distance, outgoing[origin].fetch(target, distance)].max
          outgoing[origin][target] = incoming[target][origin] = distance
        end
      end
      pending = incoming.transform_values(&:size)
      ready = representatives.select { |v| pending[v].zero? }
      ordered, y1, y2 = [], {}, {}
      until ready.empty?
        v = ready.pop
        ordered << v
        y1[v] = incoming[v].map { |u, d| y1[u] + d }.max || 0
        outgoing[v].each_key do |w|
          pending[w] -= 1
          ready << w if pending[w].zero?
        end
      end
      ordered.reverse_each do |v|
        y2[v] = y1[v]
        y2[v] = [y1[v], outgoing[v].map { |w, d| y2[w] - d }.min].max unless outgoing[v].empty?
      end
      coordinates = root.map { |v| leftward ? y2[v] : -y2[v] }
      low = count.times.map { |v| coordinates[v] - left[v] }.min
      high = count.times.map { |v| coordinates[v] + right[v] }.max
      layouts[variant], blocks[variant] = coordinates, representatives.size
      bounds[variant], spans[variant] = [low, high], high - low + 1
    end
    smallest = VARIANTS.min_by { |v| spans[v] }
    aligned = VARIANTS.to_h do |v|
      side = v[1] == 'l' ? 0 : 1
      shift = bounds[smallest][side] - bounds[v][side]
      [v, layouts[v].map { |x| x + shift }]
    end
    x = count.times.map do |v|
      values = VARIANTS.map { |k| aligned[k][v] }.sort
      (values[1] + values[2]) / 2
    end
    low = count.times.map { |v| x[v] - left[v] }.min
    Result.new(x.map { |value| value - low }, left, right, aligned, blocks, spans, smallest, marked)
  end
end

module Crossing
  def self.positions(orders)
    orders.each_with_object({}) { |layer, result| layer.each_with_index { |v, p| result[v] = p } }
  end

  def self.accumulator(segments, position, size)
    capacity = 1
    capacity *= 2 while capacity < size
    tree = Array.new(2 * capacity - 1, 0)
    count = 0
    segments.map { |p, q, _| [position[p], position[q]] }.sort.each do |_, q|
      k = q + capacity - 1
      tree[k] += 1
      while k.positive?
        count += tree[k + 1] if k.odd?
        k = (k - 1) / 2
        tree[k] += 1
      end
    end
    count
  end

  def self.cross?(a, b, position)
    (position[a[0]] - position[b[0]]) * (position[a[1]] - position[b[1]]) < 0
  end

  def self.brute_force(segments, position)
    segments.combination(2).count { |a, b| cross?(a, b, position) }
  end

  def self.gap_counts(gaps, orders)
    position = positions(orders)
    gaps.each_with_index.map { |segments, i| accumulator(segments, position, orders[i + 1].size) }
  end

  def self.total(gaps, orders)
    gap_counts(gaps, orders).sum
  end

  def self.local(gaps, orders, layer)
    position = positions(orders)
    [layer - 1, layer].select { |i| i >= 0 && i < gaps.size }.sum do |i|
      accumulator(gaps[i], position, orders[i + 1].size)
    end
  end

  def self.adjacent(v, w, upper, lower, position)
    [upper, lower].sum { |neighbors| neighbors[v].sum { |a| neighbors[w].count { |b| position[a] > position[b] } } }
  end
end

module GraphIO
  DEFAULTS = { 'layering' => 'longest', 'width' => 4, 'promotion' => 'off',
               'heuristic' => 'barycenter', 'sweeps' => 12, 'node_sep' => 2,
               'dummy_sep' => 1, 'layer_gap' => 3, 'direction' => 'TB',
               'sifting' => 'off', 'reduce' => 'off', 'restarts' => 0, 'seed' => 1 }.freeze
  CHOICES = { 'layering' => %w[longest coffman], 'promotion' => %w[on off],
              'heuristic' => %w[barycenter median], 'direction' => %w[TB BT LR RL],
              'sifting' => %w[on off], 'reduce' => %w[on off] }.freeze
  RANGES = { 'width' => 1..40, 'sweeps' => 0..50, 'node_sep' => 1..9,
             'dummy_sep' => 1..9, 'layer_gap' => 2..9, 'restarts' => 0..9,
             'seed' => 1..2_147_483_646 }.freeze
  Graph = Struct.new(:name, :settings, :nodes, :edges, :path, :self_loops, :duplicates, :error)

  def self.value(name, word)
    return word if CHOICES[name]&.include?(word)
    return unless RANGES.key?(name) && /\A[0-9]{1,10}\z/.match?(word)
    number = word.to_i
    number if RANGES[name].cover?(number)
  end

  def self.lines(file)
    File.foreach(File.join('input', file)).with_index(1) do |line, number|
      line = line.chomp
      yield number, line.split(' ') unless line.empty? || line.start_with?('#')
    end
  end

  def self.read
    defaults = DEFAULTS.dup
    lines('params.txt') { |_, (name, word)| defaults[name] = value(name, word) }
    graphs = []
    graph = nil
    lines('graphs.txt') do |number, fields|
      kind, first, second = fields
      if kind == 'GRAPH'
        graph = Graph.new(first, defaults.dup, {}, [], nil, 0, 0, nil)
        graphs << graph
        next
      end
      if kind == 'END'
        graph.error = ['no_nodes', number] if graph.error.nil? && graph.nodes.empty?
        next
      end
      next if graph.error
      error = nil
      case kind
      when 'OPTION'
        setting = value(first, second)
        setting.nil? ? error = 'bad_option' : graph.settings[first] = setting
      when 'NODE'
        id = first.to_i
        if graph.nodes.key?(id)
          error = 'duplicate_node'
        elsif graph.nodes.size == 40
          error = 'too_many_nodes'
        else
          graph.nodes[id] = second
        end
      else
        a, b = first.to_i, second.to_i
        if !graph.nodes.key?(a) || !graph.nodes.key?(b)
          error = 'unknown_node'
        elsif kind == 'PATH'
          graph.path = [a, b]
        elsif a == b
          graph.self_loops += 1
        elsif graph.edges.include?([a, b])
          graph.duplicates += 1
        else
          graph.edges << [a, b]
        end
      end
      graph.error = [error, number] if error
    end
    graphs
  end
end
